title: The Letters of Sandpiper Point
author: Felix Hartwell
blurb: Theo Sterling, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
